summary: Completed e2e testing of 'Ranking do Povão - Pace Livre' feature. All backend APIs working (12/12 tests passed). Frontend UI displays ranking type selector, modalidade selection in cadastro, and Povão view with stats/filters. Minor fix applied: added modalidade_usuario to /auth/me endpoint response.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: /api/auth/me endpoint was missing modalidade_usuario field - now returns user's modality for proper frontend state management
seed_data_creation: Created test Povão athletes during automated tests (auto-cleaned)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ranking do Povão feature fully implemented. Povão ranking shows 0 athletes because no results have been submitted yet - this is expected as the feature is new. The calcular_ranking_povao() function processes submitted results correctly.

1_cadastro_modalidade_selection.description: Cadastro page displays two modalidade cards: 'Atleta Profissional/Amador' (points by position) and 'Ranking do Povão - Pace Livre' (points by distance). Cards are selectable with visual feedback (emerald/purple borders).

2_pcd_cadeirante_validation.description: Backend correctly rejects PCD/Cadeirante athletes from selecting povao_pace_livre modality with 400 status and clear error message.

3_ranking_povao_endpoint.description: GET /api/ranking/povao?genero=M|F returns correct structure: genero (Masculino/Feminino), total_atletas, ranking array with colocacao, atleta_id, nome, pontos, total_corridas, distancia_acumulada.

4_ranking_povao_stats_endpoint.description: GET /api/ranking/povao/stats returns: total_atletas_masculino, total_atletas_feminino, total_atletas, total_provas, total_pontos.

5_ranking_page_tipo_selector.description: Ranking page displays type selector with 'Ranking Profissional/Amador' and 'Ranking do Povão' buttons. Clicking toggles between views correctly.

6_povao_view_stats_cards.description: Povão view displays 4 stats cards: Atletas Povão, Masculino, Feminino, Provas Registradas. All with correct purple/pink/blue/amber gradients.

7_povao_gender_filter.description: Povão ranking shows Masculino/Feminino filter buttons. Clicking toggles between gender-specific rankings.

8_povao_points_explanation.description: Povão view displays points system explanation: '5km a 9km = 5 pontos', '10km a 20km = 7 pontos', '21km ou mais = 9 pontos'. Also shows tiebreaker criteria.

9_admin_modalidade_filter.description: Admin Dashboard Atletas section includes modalidade filter: 'Todas', 'Profissional/Amador', 'Ranking do Povão'. Athletes show modalidade badge (Pro/Amador or Povão).

10_submeter_resultado_adaptation.description: SubmeterResultadoPage checks user.modalidade_usuario and hides colocacao/tempo fields for Povão athletes. Shows purple theme and distance-based points info.

register_pcd_povao_blocked.description: Correctly blocks PCD athlete from selecting Povão modality

register_cadeirante_povao_blocked.description: Correctly blocks Cadeirante athlete from selecting Povão modality

auth_me_returns_modalidade.description: Now returns modalidade_usuario field for proper frontend state

fix_applied.description: Added modalidade_usuario to /api/auth/me response so frontend can properly detect user's modality for SubmeterResultadoPage adaptation
